## AX.25 Packet Node GB7CAM

GB7CAM is a 2m AX.25 packet radio node serving the Cambridge area.  The station provides node, mailbox and chat services using LINBPQ and is connected to the wider packet radio network via RF and IP links.

<div id="api-status-widget" class="status-card metric-grid">

```{=html}
<script>
/* ----------------------------
   CONSTANTS & HELPERS
---------------------------- */
const RF_PORT = 1;
const AXIP_PORT = 3;
const FOUR_HOURS_MS = 4 * 60 * 60 * 1000;

function parseTime(st) {
  if (!st?.lastHeard) return NaN;

  const [datePart, timePart] = st.lastHeard.split(" ");
  if (!datePart || !timePart) return NaN;

  const [y, m, d] = datePart.split("-").map(Number);
  const [hh, mm, ss = 0] = timePart.split(":").map(Number);

  return Date.UTC(y, m - 1, d, hh, mm, ss);
}

/* ----------------------------
   FETCH DATA
---------------------------- */
async function fetchWidgetTelemetry() {
  const statusEl = document.getElementById("api-status-widget");

  function setOffline() {
    statusEl.classList.remove("status-card--good", "status-card--bad");
    statusEl.classList.add("status-card--bad");

    document.getElementById("w-status").innerText = "Offline";
    document.getElementById("w-links").innerText = "—";
    document.getElementById("w-rf").innerText = "—";
    document.getElementById("w-axip").innerText = "—";
    document.getElementById("w-last").innerText = "No data";
  }

  const base = "https://api.gb7cam.org.uk";

  try {
    const [linksRes, mheardRes] = await Promise.all([
      fetch(base + "/links"),
      fetch(base + "/mheard/all")
    ]);

    if (!linksRes.ok || !mheardRes.ok) {
      setOffline();
      return;
    }

    const links = (await linksRes.json()).links || [];
    const rawMheard = (await mheardRes.json()).mheard || [];
    const cutoff = Date.now() - FOUR_HOURS_MS;

    // Filter and clean incoming data based on the 4-hour window
    const mheardAll = rawMheard
      .map(st => ({ ...st, ts: parseTime(st) }))
      .filter(st => !isNaN(st.ts) && st.ts >= cutoff);

    /* ----------------------------
       COMPUTE METRICS
    ---------------------------- */
    let rf = 0, axip = 0, latest = 0, latestCall = "";

    for (const st of mheardAll) {
      const port = Number(st.port);

      if (st.ts > latest) {
        latest = st.ts;
        latestCall = st.callSign;
      }

      if (port === RF_PORT) rf++;
      if (port === AXIP_PORT) axip++;
    }

    // Output Telemetry Metrics to DOM
    document.getElementById("w-links").innerText = links.length;
    document.getElementById("w-rf").innerText = rf;
    document.getElementById("w-axip").innerText = axip;

    document.getElementById("w-last").innerText =
      latest
        ? `${latestCall} - ${Math.floor((Date.now() - latest) / 60000)} mins ago`
        : "No data";

    const ok = links.length > 0;

    statusEl.classList.remove("status-card--good", "status-card--bad");
    if (ok) {
      statusEl.classList.add("status-card--good");
      document.getElementById("w-status").innerText = "Operational";
    } else {
      statusEl.classList.add("status-card--bad");
      document.getElementById("w-status").innerText = "Degraded";
    }

  } catch (e) {
    setOffline();
    console.error("Widget fetch offline:", e);
  }
}

/* ----------------------------
   INITIALIZE TIMERS
---------------------------- */
document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", () => {
  fetchWidgetTelemetry();
  setInterval(fetchWidgetTelemetry, 60000);
});
</script>
